data.name: Kamitha
data.long_meaning: The name Kamitha is derived from the Sanskrit language, and it is the name of the goddess of desire and love in Hindu mythology. The name Kamitha is believed to represent the feminine aspect of the divine, embodying passion, creativity, and sensuality. According to Hindu scriptures, Kamitha is the wife of Lord Kama, the god of love. She is also known as Rati, the goddess of sexual pleasure and marital happiness. The name Kamitha is deeply rooted in Hindu culture and is considered a powerful and auspicious name for a girl.
